notes: TCG multiplayer: duel a friend online. TCG → Play a friend → Create a room gives a 5-letter code; your friend picks Join a room and types it. Works between PC, Mac, iPhone and the web, also on different Wi-Fi. You each play your own deck, the coin flip winner chooses who goes first, and the friend's device reconnects by itself if the connection drops. A win gives 40 Obols, a loss 10.
